MWI.note: The judiciary's in-house system is 90% developed and only piloted, not live.

facts.fact: The Malawi Judiciary's ICT Department reported on 2 February 2024 that its in-house Case Management Statistics System, 90% developed, was installed in a pilot phase in ten magistrate courts, with later deployment to all district magistrate courts.

MWI.note: The report is about court networks, not local government offices.
